about.title: Our Story
about.origin_text: Born in Tamraght, Kinomori fuses Japanese precision with Moroccan soul — every plate tells two stories.
about.philosophy_text: We believe in slow food: seasonal ingredients, traditional techniques, and the warmth of sharing.
about.chef_text: 15+ years of experience in Tokyo, Osaka, and now Morocco — a bridge between two worlds.
